title: Scaling a Chat System
subtitle: Stop asking the server for messages and let it tell you
motto: Poll less, push more, and plan for the reconnect
keyInsight: Polling wastes almost every request; a persistent connection makes traffic proportional to real messages but turns a restart into a reconnect storm.

decisions.title: Count wasted polls, not just total requests
decisions.description: The sim reports the share of polls that find nothing, because that is the cost of polling that WebSockets remove.
decisions.alternatives: Reporting only request rate would show a big number without saying why it is wasteful.

decisions.title: Show the reconnect storm as the WebSocket failure
decisions.description: Long-lived connections fail in a new way, everyone reconnecting together, so the failure frame ties this chapter to the retry pattern in p10.
decisions.alternatives: A single server crash is less dramatic with a large fleet and would not show the real risk of persistent connections.
